definitions.explanation: Providing a benefit or advantage; in a position that is likely to lead to success.

examples.japanese: この{条件|じょうけん}は{私|わたし}たちに{有利|ゆうり}だ。
examples.english: These conditions are favorable to us.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有利|ゆうり}な{立場|たちば}にいる。
examples.english: He is in an advantageous position.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}を{有利|ゆうり}に{進|すす}めたい。
examples.english: I want to advance the negotiations in our favor.

notes:
USAGE: {有利|ゆうり} describes situations, conditions, or positions that give an advantage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{有利|ゆうり}な{条件|じょうけん} (favorable conditions)
・{有利|ゆうり}な{立場|たちば} (advantageous position)
・{有利|ゆうり}に{働|はたら}く (to work in one's favor)
・{有利|ゆうり}に{進|すす}める (to advance favorably)

CONTRAST:
・{不利|ふり} - disadvantageous, unfavorable
